authorization: User explicitly made the PC available and authorised any testing to improve the engine on 2026-10-15
objective: Test whether a small residual head offers enough held-out quality to justify its additional equal-time inference cost

data.partition: Existing validation source partitioned deterministically by game identity before sampling; no game crosses current validation/test
audits: selected effective-input SHA256 overlap/deduplication across train/validation/test
data.cache: Float32 clipped frozen transformer outputs in STM-first order; no half-precision activation approximation
data.limits: The pretrained source was already selected using the existing validation corpus. This subdivision is a diagnostic holdout for this fine-tuning study, not a globally untouched test set or a full-source effective-input audit.

training.checkpointRule: Minimum validation objective among epoch 0 and completed epochs 1..20, first minimum retained
training.matchedBudget: Identical positions, batches, shuffle order, starting direct prediction and optimiser updates per seed/arm; measured GPU time may differ and is recorded

offlineDecision.primary: Mean relative validation WDL loss improvement versus equally trained direct controls across both seeds
offlineDecision.architectureSelection: Largest mean validation relative reduction among eligible R4/R8; tie selects R4
offlineDecision.testDisclosure: Evaluate diagnostic test only after all model checkpoints are selected; no hyperparameter retuning based on these outcomes
offlineDecision.testGate: Paired game-cluster bootstrap 95% upper loss-difference bound below zero, and aggregate direction survives exact integer-export evaluation

conditionalStrengthScreen.opponent: Equally fine-tuned direct head for each corresponding training seed
conditionalStrengthScreen.searchOptions: Same frozen executable and options for both sides; ProbCut and singular extensions off
conditionalStrengthScreen.decision: Exploratory cost-aware screen only. No default/promotion or established Elo claim from a small, post-selection sample. Preserve all results; no optional extensions to chase significance.

independentEngineeringWork: Separately measure compact stack-scratch implementation with identical weights, trees and search settings; do not attribute any speed change to learned model quality
